## Change

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

Describe the scenario you manually exercised, the expected behavior, and the observed result. Include screenshots or other evidence where useful.

## PR checklist

- [ ] I have manually tested the change to validate that it is working.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests covering the changed observable behavior, or explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] My UI changes use locale messages for new or changed user-facing text, including accessibility labels, with all supported locale catalogs updated; or this change does not affect UI text.
- [ ] I have run relevant automated checks and reported any failures or checks not run.

Only check manual validation after exercising the affected behavior; passing automated tests alone does not satisfy it.
